minion_todo_read.description: Compatibility entry: use dupes_control domain=side_screen action=todos. Read the current, available and blocked chores, priorities and targets from MinionTodoSideScreen without refreshing native precondition caches.
minion_todo_read.name: Optional duplicant name
minion_todo_read.include_blocked: Include failed or blocked chores. Default: true.
minion_todo_read.include_potential_only: For blocked chores, exclude only known IsPotentialSuccess=false results; retain unknown results with potentialSuccess=null. Default: true.
minion_todo_read.query: Filter by duplicant, chore, target, group or blocked reason
minion_todo_read.task_limit: Maximum chores returned per duplicant. Default: 30; maximum: 100.
minion_todo_read.unknown_note: Some potential results are unknown because the native precondition cache is pending or unavailable. Unknown blocked chores remain included even with includePotentialOnly=true; no cache refresh was requested.
